lines.text: Runner. Mara here. You're carrying a relay key the city grid thinks was destroyed. Keep moving. I'll handle the route.
We've got a watcher behind you. Not a problem yet. Keep your rhythm.
Runner, you've got company. Another runner is closing fast. Move.
Keep running. I can see you. You won't keep the gap.
Air unit above us. They've got visual. Keep running. Cover ahead. Get under it.
You're almost clear, Runner. Bring the relay key home.
Key received. Nobody should have known that relay existed.
The key contains a transmission timestamped tomorrow.
Runner. Same channel. The packet on that key predicts things before the grid sees them. We're taking it analogue.
Someone just mirrored your direction change. Assume you're being tailed and keep your rhythm.
Tail confirmed. They're accelerating. Open a gap if you've got it.
I saw you change direction. It won't save you. Keep moving.
Rotor noise inbound. Air unit is searching your corridor. Keep moving to cover.
Dead-drop is close. Don't slow down for the handoff.
Packet dropped. Mara's reader found a map hidden inside the timestamps.
The map marks a route you ran before the app existed.
Runner, the map is live. There's another signal moving through the same streets as you. We don't know who is carrying it.
Second signal is matching your pace. Too clean to be coincidence.
They're closing now. Move. I want to know whether they can actually keep up with you.
You want to know if I can keep up? Turn around and find out.
Police air unit just joined the search. Use the route. Cover is ahead.
Signal is breaking away. Finish the route and I'll triangulate it.
Triangulation complete. The other signal used your Runner identifier.
Someone has been filing missions under your name.
The bait is live. Whoever borrowed your name accepted the job twelve seconds ago. Keep moving and let them think you're following their route.
They're reacting to us in real time. That means our channel isn't as private as I thought.
Contact moving fast. Don't chase the person. Chase the signal. Give me the pace change I need to separate you.
Don't chase the signal. Chase me. I'm already ahead of you.
Police helicopter just lit up the corridor. Both Runner IDs are exposed. Get under cover.
I've got enough. Bring yourself out clean and I'll burn this channel.
Channel burned. The copied identifier wasn't forged externally. It was issued by our own network.
Mara's credentials signed the duplicate Runner ID.
Runner, quick courier job. Package is live and the clock is already moving. Keep your route clean.
Passive tail behind you. Keep your rhythm and make them work for the read.
Tail just committed. Move.
Your package is mine if you slow down. Keep moving.
Air unit scanning. Stay moving and use cover ahead.
Package window is nearly closed. Bring it in.
Courier package delivered clean.
Another job is already waiting.
We've got a blind spot in the grid. You're going through it before somebody patches it.
Cameras behind you just came back online. Keep moving.
Ground unit is trying to close the blind spot with you inside it. Move.
The blind spot closes around you. Run while it lasts.
Air unit filling the gap from above. Cover ahead.
You're nearly out of the mesh. Keep the same line.
Blind spot crossed. It wasn't an accident.
Somebody opened it for you.
Today you're the noise, Runner. Make the grid look at you while somebody else vanishes.
Good. They're tracking the decoy. Keep feeding them a believable line.
They've decided the decoy is real. Time to sell it. Move.
They think you're the courier. Let them. I know which way you're going.
Air unit bought the signal too. Get under cover and make them overshoot.
Decoy job is done. Bring yourself back clean.
The real courier disappeared exactly where we needed them to.
The grid still thinks you were carrying the package.
Nice. You opened the gap. They lost the line. Settle back into your rhythm.
They're still with you. Don't force it. Keep moving and I'll change the plan.
They've cut you off. Change of plan. Keep moving. This isn't over.
You got lucky. Keep running.
You opened a gap, but not enough. I'm still with you.
You hit the wall. Keep moving. This isn't over.
Cover reached. They've lost visual. Nice work. Keep moving.
